notes:
# v1.3.42 — reader auto-next going backward

- Fixed: when a chapter auto-advanced at the end of the chapter, it could jump
  **backwards** to the previous chapter (e.g. from Chapter 63 to Chapter 62
  instead of Chapter 64). Chapters are now always ordered newest-first
  internally, so the next chapter is always the correct one, whatever order the
  source listed them in.
- Fixed: "Start Reading" now always opens the first chapter, and opening a title
  from Continue Reading keeps the chapter list in the right order.
